top_findings.title: Handler init/2 returns a bare Req, violating the cowboy_handler contract — every route crashes its request process
top_findings.evidence: src/books_http_handler.erl:5,12 — init/2 clauses tail-call reply/3 (line 23) and book_route/3, all returning cowboy_req:reply/4's bare Req map; cowboy 2.12.0 cowboy_handler:execute/2 matches only {ok,Req,State}|{Mod,Req,State}|{Mod,Req,State,Opts}, so a bare map raises try_clause and the request process is terminated. Affects R1,R4,R5,R6,R8,R10.

top_findings.title: GET /books calls cowboy_req:qs_val/2, which does not exist in Cowboy 2.x — R2/R3 never serve
top_findings.evidence: src/books_http_handler.erl:10; rebar.config:2 and rebar.lock pin cowboy 2.12.0, where qs_val/2 was removed in Cowboy 2.0 (replaced by parse_qs/1 or match_qs/2). Any GET /books raises undefined function before any reply.

top_findings.title: No test exercises the HTTP layer, so two fatal runtime bugs pass unflagged
top_findings.evidence: test/books_api_tests.erl:4-17 — the 3 tests call decode_book/1, nonempty/1 and books_db CRUD directly; none start Cowboy, so the init/2 contract bug and qs_val undef are never caught. test_coverage=1.0 reflects only this subset.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an integration test that starts the listener and issues HTTP requests.
